newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo rose 4.5 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo rose 4.5 pct in May.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport rose 4.5 percent in May, compared with the same month last year, to 1,998 tonnes, the airport authority said.
This follows a 49.6 percent increase in April and takes the total so far this year to 11,242 tonnes, a 19.8 percent increase on 1996.
Intercontinental international freight accounted for 934 tonnes of the May total, European Union freight for 608 tonnes and domestic cargo only 456 tonnes.
Vitoria started commercial cargo operations in 1994 and showed monthly growth rates of as much as 150 percent in 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
